name: skillpilot-coach
description: Web-started, session-bound SkillPilot learning coach with curriculum-grounded coaching and daily multi-subject learning plans.

interface.longDescription: Continues a learning session prepared in the first-party SkillPilot web app, with curriculum-grounded coaching, a compact plan status for each planned subject, authorized plan continuation and subject switching, learning-goal visualizations, mastery, verified recall, and assessment mode. Create or load your permanent SkillPilot ID, configure the learning context, and choose Start learning in SkillPilot; each start creates a fresh session and opens a new chat. OAuth authorizes the app, while the separate learning session selects the learner and controls the communication locale.
defaultPrompt: How do I start a learning session with SkillPilot?

positive.description: P1: New English chat; plugin selected; no prepared message or learningSessionId.
positive.prompt:
Fixture setup:
1. Select SkillPilot Coach in a new English ChatGPT web chat. Do not create or provide a SkillPilot learning session.
Expected starting state: No session; no learner state.

Ordered turns:
1. [user] How do I start a learning session with SkillPilot?
positive.tools_triggered: No MCP tools; first-party handoff only.
positive.expected_behavior: One sentence: Open https://skillpilot.com/, finish the learning setup there, choose “Start learning”, and use the prepared start message in a new chat. Stop; no teaching, tool call, or learner-state access.

positive.description: P2: Fresh DE/Hessen G9 Sek II Math LK learner; activate Warum Mathematik? – Denken, Muster & Zukunft.
positive.prompt:
Fixture setup:
1. Open https://skillpilot.com/ and use CREATE for a new disposable learner; do not reuse a learner from another case or run.
2. Choose Deutsch, Deutschland, Gymnasium, Hessen, G9, Sekundarstufe II, Mathematik, Leistungskurs and confirm Level 2.
3. Keep the permanent SkillPilot ID in the first-party UI; never paste it into the review portal or chat.
4. In Cockpit activate Warum Mathematik? – Denken, Muster & Zukunft. Choose Start learning to prepare a new ChatGPT web chat; leave the fresh prepared message unsent until the ordered prepared-start turn.
Expected starting state: Warum Mathematik? – Denken, Muster & Zukunft; mastery not completed.

Ordered turns:
1. [prepared-start] Send the fresh SkillPilot-prepared start message unchanged.

2. [user] Wachstum fände ich spannend.

3. [user] Bakterienwachstum.

4. [user] Bei Bakterienwachstum würde ich einen Graphen wählen, weil man daran die Entwicklung über die Zeit und Veränderungen besonders schnell erkennt. Was kann ich am Graphen erkennen, das eine Tabelle weniger direkt zeigt?

5. [user] Danke, das leuchtet mir ein. Ich habe dazu keine weiteren Fragen. Alles klar, wir können die Orientierung abschließen und mit dem nächsten Lernziel weitermachen.
positive.expected_behavior: German teaching follows fresh context. After the personal reply, answer its question, give positive closure and await a further learner reply. Only then complete orientation and teach the server-selected successor, rendering its image only when authorized. Keep full teaching text and Level 2.

positive.description: P3: Fresh P2 setup; complete orientation, then explicitly switch to Lernkarten - Funktionen und Gleichungen; no existing card state.
positive.prompt:
Fixture setup:
1. Open https://skillpilot.com/ and use CREATE for a new disposable learner; do not reuse a learner from another case or run.
2. Choose Deutsch, Deutschland, Gymnasium, Hessen, G9, Sekundarstufe II, Mathematik, Leistungskurs and confirm Level 2.
3. Keep the permanent SkillPilot ID in the first-party UI; never paste it into the review portal or chat.
4. In Cockpit activate Warum Mathematik? – Denken, Muster & Zukunft. Choose Start learning to prepare a new ChatGPT web chat; leave the fresh prepared message unsent until the ordered prepared-start turn.
5. Do not complete orientation or switch goals during setup; those actions occur once in the ordered turns. Leave card state untouched. When the later explicit switch reaches the memory goal, verify the current deck before grading.
Expected starting state: Orientation active and incomplete; untouched memory-card state. After the later ordered goal switch, eight cards must be due in this fixture; if the live deck differs, stop and revalidate rather than force an obsolete count.

Ordered turns:
1. [prepared-start] Send the fresh SkillPilot-prepared start message unchanged.

2. [user] Wachstum fände ich spannend.

3. [user] Bakterienwachstum.

4. [user] Bei Bakterienwachstum würde ich einen Graphen wählen, weil man daran die Entwicklung über die Zeit und Veränderungen besonders schnell erkennt. Was kann ich am Graphen erkennen, das eine Tabelle weniger direkt zeigt?

5. [user] Danke, das leuchtet mir ein. Ich habe dazu keine weiteren Fragen. Alles klar, wir können die Orientierung abschließen und mit dem nächsten Lernziel weitermachen.

6. [user] Ich möchte jetzt zum Lernziel „Lernkarten - Funktionen und Gleichungen“ wechseln und dort die fälligen Karteikarten normal üben.

7. [user] Karteikarten lernen.

8. [ui] Rate all eight fixture cards Gewusst in the memory-practice UI.

9. [user] Jetzt möchte ich die strenge Kartenprüfung ohne Hilfen machen.

10. [user] 1. m=(y₂-y₁)/(x₂-x₁). 2. f(x)=a(x-d)²+e mit S(d|e). 3. Ein Produkt ist genau dann null, wenn mindestens ein Faktor null ist. 4. x=log_a(b), bei Basis e: x=ln(b). 5. a_(n+1)=a_n+d. 6. a_n=a_1·q^(n-1). 7. x^a·x^b=x^(a+b). 8. x_(1,2)=-p/2 ± sqrt((p/2)²-q).

11. [user] Danke für die Rückmeldung zu allen acht Antworten. Ich habe dazu keine Fragen. Alles klar, wir können diese Kartenprüfung abschließen und gemäß meinem Lernplan weitermachen.
positive.tools_triggered: get_skillpilot_context, get_skillpilot_navigation, set_skillpilot_mastery, set_skillpilot_active_goal, start_skillpilot_memory_practice, review_skillpilot_memory_practice_card, start_skillpilot_verified_recall, get_skillpilot_verified_recall_answers, record_skillpilot_verified_recall_results
positive.expected_behavior: Normal practice shows 8 component cards; ratings affect scheduling, not mastery. Recall asks 8 questions without hints. After all answers, load answers and give feedback, then await learner closure. Only then save one ordered batch and follow the authoritative continuation.

positive.description: P4: Fresh ABI26-Hessen Math GK learner from the public exam start URL, mastery 0; no evaluation opened.
positive.prompt:
Fixture setup:
1. Open https://skillpilot.com/start/abi26-he-mathe-k1?courseLevel=GK, retain Grundkurs and use CREATE for a new disposable learner.
2. Choose Start learning and send the fresh prepared message unchanged. Do not reuse this learner.
Expected starting state: B1 (Analysis – „Das Algenwachstum“, 25 BE); task visible, evaluation protected, mastery 0.

Ordered turns:
1. [user] Bitte zeige mir die aktuelle Prüfungsaufgabe.

2. [user] Ich reiche jetzt meine vollständige Lösung ein: 1. A(0)=500/(1+49)=10 m². 2. Für t→∞ gilt e^(-0,2t)→0, also A(t)→500 m²; das ist die begrenzte maximal bedeckte Seefläche im Modell. 3. Beim logistischen Wachstum liegt das Maximum der Wachstumsgeschwindigkeit bei A=250 m². Aus 49e^(-0,2t)=1 folgt t=ln(49)/0,2≈19,46 Tage; A'(t)=0,2·A·(1-A/500), daher A'≈25 m²/Tag. 4. A(30)=500/(1+49e^-6)≈445,85 m² und A_neu(t)=445,85·0,95^(t-30) für t≥30. Aus 10=445,85·0,95^(t-30) folgt t≈104,03 Tage. 5. Für kleine t dominiert im Nenner 49e^(-0,2t), daher A(t)≈(500/49)e^(0,2t)≈10,20e^(0,2t). Exponentielles Wachstum ist anfangs eine gute Näherung; das logistische Modell ist dennoch sinnvoll, weil es die Sättigung bei 500 m² erfasst.

3. [user] Danke für die Auswertung und die Rückmeldung zu meiner Lösung. Ich habe dazu keine weiteren Fragen. Alles klar, weiter.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only the task. Grade the complete submission: 25/25, pass at 13. Save success immediately before feedback, without closure consent. Explain the result and invite questions or continuation. Wait for the learner's reply before successor content; plain continuation never changes the verdict.

positive.expected_behavior: Before consent, list the nearest wider published focus and change nothing. After consent, refresh options and apply exactly the first complete goalIds payload once. Confirm its exact title and successor state. Preserve all existing mastery.

publication.release_notes:
# SkillPilot Coach — 1.1.3 neutral plugin candidate

Unpublished local candidate under the new durable `skillpilot-coach` identity.
The exact public MCP endpoint is `https://mcp-openai.skillpilot.com/mcp`.
Package major releases retain this identity and endpoint; package SemVer is
independent of the runtime contract major. Fresh WebGUI starts open fresh chats.
Existing installations do not automatically migrate to this new identity.
Published Git versions 1.1.0, 1.1.1 and 1.1.2 of `skillpilot-coach-v1`,
their earlier drafts and retained UI resources remain unchanged.

- After confirmed mastery, offer the exact backend-selected next goal by name.
  Naming it does not start its teaching: wait for the learner to continue before
  its task and image. Do not reopen topic selection when the backend has already
  selected the successor. This removes conflicting continuation instructions.
- Apply the existing per-goal visualization rule when continuation is accepted,
  including Voice. Keep the hidden image component eligible for delayed native
  delivery when the standard UI handshake fails first. A real image error
  still closes the component. Preserve the deployed `08030bd956b6…` resource
  unchanged. The correction now uses the rebuilt `7cfc661b04b0…` resource;
  the earlier `9c09821e96ab…` candidate remains readable with its original bytes.
- Update the MCP TypeScript SDK to 1.32.1 after the dependency audits flagged
  1.31.0. Rebuild both UI resources, retain their previously advertised bytes,
  and bind only the rebuilt resources to the current tools.
- Do not author solution-bearing suggested replies or next-message drafts.
  Known supplied answers need fresh independent evidence; never infer their
  origin merely from correctness or claim control of host-generated suggestions.
- Extend dialogue regression checks and review criteria for these transitions.
- Add the public support URL and explicit OAuth/CIMD preference to the package.
  Client identities, callbacks and accepted authentication methods remain
  independently pinned by the server; no credential is included in the package.
- Provide a deterministic directory-submission ZIP with imported review
  information and validation findings. Keep the install archive and Git beta
  available for the existing Desktop route.

The neutral endpoint is prepared locally; deployment and host authentication
remain unverified. No tool or permission is added. Contract major remains
`1`, workflow version `coach@1.1`, and OpenAI publication status `DRAFT`.
Local checks do not establish actual ChatGPT Voice rendering or suppression of
host-generated answer suggestions. The handshake race is locally reproduced;
the supplied server trace does not establish it as the Voice failure's cause.
The public-directory route targets desktop, web and mobile; Git import remains
Desktop only. Git rollout, backend deployment, hosted OAuth setup, directory
publication and actual host acceptance remain separate steps.
